rationale: Prior frozen gate independently permits local-baseline expansion. Reuse exact held1, train only five missing folds. This confirms a strong baseline rather than promoting failed full/MultiRocket configurations.

gate: Descriptive source confirmation: mean local-minus-existingMiniRocket >=1pp, >=4/6 positive users, minimum per-user difference >=-2pp. Not independent significance, eightfold improvement or an original contribution.
cost_basis: Sum observed24 local-pilot epoch times6428.193s times5 times1.2; all new folds train<=4700. No epoch/seed/model tuning. Source1 reused rather than retrained.
